notes.title: Legendary Tales August news with weekly deal!
notes.content:
Hello Urban Wolf Games fans.
It’s going to be long text. Take a cup of tea before read.

In the last announcement, I said, me and my team are going to have long vacation, but we didn’t have time to rest. Instead, we were focusing on thinking about our future.
What do we want to do? what can we do? what should we do? Make another VR game? Make a DLC for Legendary Tales?
Or can we even continue to develop VR games ever again? since this market is too tough for indie developers like us. 
The fear ate us when we saw the reaction after release 1.0, maybe leaving the PCVR market is best way. Because we are failure here. That was what we thought.

And then suddenly you, the Urban Wolf Games fan, popped up in my head.
“Maybe concrete PCVR Legendary Tales fans will still back us up in the future.”
On top of that. we have PSVR2 gaming fans, the group like the oxygen!
We almost gave up the VR development and wanted to move to PC or mobile game development. But your hot, hot, hot love made us to consider once more.

We are indie developers; we never had enough money before and now. Maybe we don’t need big pocket of money, money is just a tool. But love, towards to our game is the Oxygen. We need them, we cannot live without gamers love. That is the source of indie development I believe. 

So, I had to do something. 
First, we did what we could do.
“Digging the possibilities and Research and Develop of the possibilities.”
And then divided into many options
At this point you have questions in your head. What does that mean?
It means we are currently working on to find a solution to stay in VR market.

The options I have come up with are below
1: Make a DLC
2: Quest port of course.
3: Make new VR game

1: Make a DLC
It’s not an easy task since we have the biggest problem: Legendary Tales is made with UE4 which is very outdated. 
What if we upgrade into UE5? some of you may remember that during the development we have tried to upgrade into UE5 but we have failed. The reason was Chaos Physics problem which we can’t handle. It seems many of UE5 developers having same problem. 
As I mentioned many times Legendary Tales uses very Physics intense. Even though, we use only 60~70% of performance of target platform for Multiplayer not like any other physics VR games (others use 100% because they are single).
So, if we make Single player only It’s fine to move on to UE5 but clearly, it’s not an option.
Instead, we need to find a solution either optimizing physics or make DLC with UE4 super fast.

[b]The question is: is there enough people who want more boss and fights, adventure in Legendary Tales? And will they buy DLC? What do you think?[/b]

2: Quest port
Meta officially opened Quest market, any developer can apply the contents as Early Access, just can not expect to be exposed to all gamers on Quest store.
As some of you know Legendary Tales project itself originally started for Quest1 (That is why Legendary Tales is well optimized, all physics were already optimized for Quest1)
But Meta never accepted Legendary Tales for their market without clear reason years. But now maybe we could jump into Quest market by our own will. 
If Legendary Tales was still in Early Access, then I wouldn’t care whatever Quest does. Because I want to be loyal to our PCVR gamers whoever supported Legendary Tales with their precious money. 
As a gamer myself, I don’t like Indie developers who release their game to other platforms to grab cashes although it is still in Early Access. At least in this part, I do believe we have earned the trust from you.
We are currently proactively digging about this option.

[b]The question is: Is there enough people who want Legendary Tales on Quest store? What do you think?[/b]



3: Make a new VR game
This also can be an option. Making a new VR game sounds what we could do! Since we have finished developing a VR game, now we are officially VR game company!
We know about VR game development better than before we started developing Legendary Tales. We can make more & different fun VR game if we jump in it.
But in another hand, we must worry about market size again, PCVR market is tough, some people still have problems with our price tag, although Legendary Tales offers way more game contents than any other VR game yet. That means we have to live in indie price tag forever. But then market is small. I don’t believe we could make VR game with more contents than Legendary Tales in the future if we should expect only this much of output.

If we make new VR game, then It will be a hybrid ( the game offers both of VR and flat-gaming ) game to expand our target audiences. I do believe we can pull it out right because we understand both gaming in the right position.
Does it sound like flat-game with VR mode? Don’t worry!
It will be opposite!  It’s a VR game that support flat gaming. How it works?
We will see if we ever make new VR game. I have an idea for it. I know how to make gamers happy because I am a gamer :D

[b]The Question is: are you interested in our new game?[/b]


I have made three different options for Urban Wolf Games future. 
They are all different way to get to future, but they have common and once thing is clear.
All of them require a lot of time. We need a lot of time to explore the options.

[b]The Question is: Can you wait for us and still support us in millions of years later?[/b]

We will dive into the adventure again to surprise you.
I will let you know when we have update and news.

Please don’t think we gave up.
We won’t give up the VR development.
We want to stay in VR market.
We will stay in VR market.

It’s time to run into phase two.

We are small 5 people team Indie team,
But thousands of fans love back us up.
Are you with us?

Warm regards,
BJ

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wpmrTbW_mbw;full][/previewyoutube]
Dawn of History


Hello Legendary Tales Fans,

Are you enjoying beating Skelis and found some good Legendaries and enjoy making your own builds?

During you are enjoying Legendary Tales, I have been in GDC and look around, expand my eye-sight.
I have met many VR devs there. Many of you know them, and I had good conversation with them.
Depends on person, subjects were different, but most of them were saying same things.
How VR market is tough for Devs, and then many of them said, We, Legendary Tales devs, have a guts.
$55 for Indie game was big move and big step and they said, appreciate what we have done for market.
They needed someone to break a barrier of price tag, and that is what we did.
At some point we will drop the price like any other games, but at least, at this point I am really proud of my decision for price.
It is now proven that with the quality game like Legendary Tales, Indie devs can pull out as long as gamers support devs.

There are tons of VR games and VR devs in wild market who need your love and support.
Such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125240/Ancient_Dungeon/]Ancient Dungeon[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116540/DAVIGO_VR_vs_PC/]Davigo[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/619500/cyubeVR/]CyubeVR[/url], OVRDark, and there are tons more.
Please consider to support VR devs by buying VR games if you like any VR game, they are working really hard.

Thanks to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/619500/cyubeVR/]CyubeVR(PCVR, PSVR2)[/url] and OVRDark(PSVR2) Devs, they have provided Free keys give away for our game fans.
I will ping you all on the Discord soon, so stay tuned on our Discord if you want free VR game keys!

What is next move of Urban Wolf Games?
As I said before, we sunk money to develop Legendary Tales and I don't think we can recoup it.
We need more resources to make more contents, DLC, or sequal. That is lacking for us at this moment.
So, we are considering leaving VR industry entirely. Nothing is fixed yet, but we put many options on the table.
If we need to sell more, how about Meta? what if we release Legendary Tales on Quest store?
That is what we want because we do not want to leave the VR market, VR industry is where our Love belongs.
I am trying to talk with Meta, and let's hope we can make it.
Even it doesn't work, I promise you that I will do my best to find a solution to stay in VR industry.
(I am working on to find a solution, that is why I am super quiet on our Discord)
So, give us some room and time to manage things right.

Does that mean we will stop support Legendary Tales? Absolutely not. We will update Legendary Tales onward.

Today, we have brought new updates with Many bug fixes and new Legendary Item! 
I know some of you wanted to have two-handed hammer and that is what we brought!
Bonk! Skelis head with two-handed giant hammer and Enjoy the Legendary Tales!


As always, I really appreciate your support and love to Legendary Tales.
I will keep it in my heart forever.

Warm regards,
BJ

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wpmrTbW_mbw;full][/previewyoutube]
Dawn of History


Hello, Legendary Tales Fans.

I wish you are enjoying Legendary Tales. Lately, I focus to get information about how people are playing Legendary Tales. Just after a week of launch, many of people said too hard, but now I see there are a lot of people say it’s good or even it’s easy now although almost none of difficulty is changed. 
It makes me smile because my fundamental of VR game design is that “Make a VR game that gamer itself Level-up during the game play, not a Character level-up”

And then now many of you understand how to play VR game, why imagination is most important for VR game, make your character, make your own build with almost unlimited combinations with Stats, Skills, Items.
I am really happy many of you are talking about your own build. As a example, Glass Cannon build, I really like the build name.
After the game launch, I found that many of players want to make Mixed, Hybrid characters. You! have more imagination than I have expected! But then many people dropped their hybrid Character because of our system limitations. I was really sad, and as a game developer, I really wanted to support you, our Legendary Tales fans, with the way I could.
So, right after game launch, I planned new skill trees for you.

[h3]Today, I am glad to tell you that we have brought entire new skill tree set with 14 new skills for Hybrid character players![/h3]
So, now your imagination will get better and better and can enjoy Legendary Tales more!

[h3]On top of that, I am glad that now we support 6 different more languages (Italian, French, Portuguese-Brazil, Spanish, Polish, Czech) officially, on Steam and PSVR2 both![/h3]
Thank you for great community and help! We couldn’t push this far without your help and love.
A lot of translations are still Translator level but some of them are human translated :D
Also, Some German and Japanese are updated as well.
I didn’t know Legendary Tales can be changed this much in a Month after launch. But look at this how much we, you and us, together changed and it’s getting better only!

And then now another great news!!
[h3]Thanks to our Graphics Designer, we have brought entire Female costume sets today! 6 armors and 6 helms. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/7105f600809a5bb7aa961ac8f872e5f5ed47e846.png[/img]

I expected another month at least but she just worked in the weekend as well even though she had a flu(Voluntarily!) because she wants you to enjoy Legendary Tales.
(What a great team! I really wish everyone get approval of long vacation from our fans. )

One last thing, there is 20% sale on Steam now. As I stated earlier, We couldn’t set release sale because of Steam policy (Can’t make a sale at least a month after increase the game price). I know many of you were sad. So I put 20% this time, So don’t miss this opportunity to get Legendary Tales for yourself and your friends! (Don’t forget there is also Legendary Tales OST!) 

I am leaving to USA for GDC next week, So, let’s hope we get many good opportunities there and if anyone who visit GDC, hit me up on our Official Discord!
Also, there will be no update at least a couple of weeks since I am not at office!

So, now It’s time to go back to make your own Legendary Tales!

With all my love
BJ

Hello, Legendary Tales Fans

Already It has been a month since Legendary Tales Official release.
I feel time flies really fast. After release there were many bugs and suggestions from gamers and we were super busy, But it seems like we have done very well done. I mean after this patch list, bug list, we see things are calming down. I believe we could have done all this really fast and accurately. I appreciate all of you.

Also, I want to share the news that Legendary Tales is now officially announced #1 selling game on PSVR2 in launch month (March-2024). Anyway I really appreciate all of VR game fans. We all made this together.
You are a one of us, who made this great history.

At same time, I still believe there are people who want to play our game, but hesitating to buy Legendary Tales because of Language barriers. So, we currently are focusing on Language support first. I hope we can deliver all Languages at same time for people from all of the world. Hang on tight!
And I wish more language support helps our Legendary Tales fans too.

There is a small news, me(BJ) and one of dev, will visit GDC 2024, Mon to Fri whole week. We want to see the world, how gaming industry is spinning around. We want to expand our eye-sight by seeing things. But at same time there is nothing to do much in GDC for us since we are just visiting. So, if anyone who visit GDC as a gamer, Dev, let me know. Maybe we can have fun time :D
I have made GDC-Talk channel in our official Discord (Here : https://discord.gg/urbanwolfgames)
Let me know on the channel if you visit GDC. Also I am going to text there during the GDC where I am.

-OST : Desolate Moonlight -

Hello, Legendary Tales fans.
Third patch Is now available. (Already pushed)
From the 1.0 update, we have been working to solve problems our fans have ASAP for the clean game experience for our fans.

As always, we have brought some features that our fans asked. Such as Inventory organize, enemy HP UI on/off feature for better immersion, added “!” mark to own Graveyard only to find it easy and more. I really appreciate all your feedback and as always, we are happy to help you, our fans and gamers.

**Since last update, many of Steam users have written reviews, some of them changed their opinions. Because people changed, updated their opinions on Steam review, now new users can have up-to-date information about the game, and it actually helped our sales a bit! I guess they read your reviews, I believe I meant something. I really appreciate your help. 
We are still mostly positive on Steam, I know we can’t make everyone happy, but if you are satisfied, please concern to write review on Steam to help us. **

Also, Let me remind you, There is Legendary Tales OST is published on Steam. Some people ask me how to support Legendary Tales project and us. Buying OST is easiest way to do it.
(And we don’t need to pay 5% of royalties to Unreal Engine for OST sales!)

Following the last announcement, we are currently working on Localization for many different languages. Thanks for great community! As a result, we could support these languages in the future: English, Korean, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Czech.
(It is not final list, depends on how it goes, can be vary at the end)
Based on what I see. some of them are just translator level of Localization, but still, I think it means a lot for some our fans in the world.

To support new languages, we need to focus on texts, it needs a lot of time and when it is finished, it needs Full QA again to support new languages on PSVR2. It means we can’t push any update until we finish Localization.
So, we can’t push any update anytime soon even there is serious problem anyone find during this period.
Thank you for your patient and understand.

Best regards,

BJ

Hello, Legendary Tales fans.
Second patch is now available. (Already pushed)
I see many of gamers are playing, enjoying Legendary Tales and they love it since the launch!
We, our team, worked hard this time again, to make best form of Legendary Tales to give you best experiences.

I am happy to say, this update includes Hybrid-grip method for PSVR2 users, seated mode for many of chair, couch players, sitting button for who has back pain. On top of that, there are many new players who feel they have made mistake for secondary and skill tree. We brought limited character reset, each character will have one chance to reset secondary attributes and skill tree. It’s only once. We are happy to help players who made mistake. I wish you learned something from your first mistake and don’t make same mistake again. Think enough before you invest points, use it wisely.

I do believe that Devs exists to help players to have fun with the game and change frustrations into motivation. That is what I want to do with patch, updates. I hope this patch/update help you to enjoy the game.

Negative reviews with outdated information are not helping game at all. In-fact it is hurting Legendary Tales more than you ever can think. As I said before, we make game together I believe, we can’t do this alone without your support. So, Please… would you help us?[/h3]

One last thing, I want to let you know that we are currently working on more localization. French is already work in progress, Thanks to one of our community user @Pommespanzer. I believe this is great part of Indie development, users, and us, can make the game better and better. It’s not just Pommeepanzer, I am really happy that all users are working together to help each other in any community I see. I feel we are all connected as a gamer with our game, Legendary Tales.

BJ

notes.title: Journey of Legendary Tales
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=17kg7nBz7yI;full][/previewyoutube]
One of our new Original Sound Track [b]‘Journey of Legendary Tales’[/b]
Song produced by BJ

[b][h3][Recommend to play the song before start to read][/h3][/b]



Hello, our old friends/Legendary Tales fans. 
In the last announcement, I have promised you that I will make another announcement in Feb 2024. Well, I have to break the promise. instead, I give you announcement earlier.
So, what it is about today?

Today, I am thrilled to tell you that Legendary Tales is finally going to leave Early Access(EA) and we are going to release 1.0 soon™

soon™ again? No, Today I can give you the time!
So, when? Feb 8, 2024!
Yes! It is just a little bit more than a week from this announcement.

As I promised you guys long time ago, I want to explain journey of Legendary Tales development.
(If you don’t want to waste your time our diary, then skip and scroll down to 1.0 update list)

[h3]1. Broken dream?[/h3]
It was Dec 2021, after Magic and skill tree update, I really wanted to make Legendary Tales as bigger project than what we had that time because I had a goal and a dream before EA releases. But as everyone know we didn’t sell that well… because all VR market was looking at modding supported VR game only and many of people didn’t want to support actual VR games that is built as pure VR game from the ground, like LT. On top of that we were denied by Meta many times already. I felt we don’t have future so, I was shaking with fear that I might need to shrink 90% of future plan I had.

[h3]2. Maybe…? Faith in dream[/h3]
It was Jan 2022, after holiday, some of Youtubers covered LT on their channel. There was sudden spike of sales and it surprised me. It was still not enough to cover the future plan of development, but I could see maybe…? Then PSVR2 was announced…
Feb 2022, I contacted to PlayStation in Korea, with a hope that they might interested in Legendary Tales. It was right call, SIEK said absolutely they want to bring it into PSVR2.
That moment, I could see the possibility… and they said they will give us Dev Kit when it is available before PSVR2 releases. When I heard that, I could see the light, my dream, our team’s dream can be true. I have decided to push as much as possible, bet on the future again. I started to carve the Legendary Tales 1.0 in my head. It couldn’t be the same size have dreamed, but I really wanted to push to the limit with the resources that what I have.

[h3]3. Loyalty, Brotherhoods… are important, no one left behind?[/h3]
A while after new world update announcement, we have decided to move to UE5 then we got PSVR2. It worked just okay on PSVR2 despite we were developing LT only on PC. So, we could release LT as launching title (Or launch window title) of PSVR2 if we wanted. 
But then I realized that performance cost (required target spec on PC) went to too high. That means many of our PC game fans will be sad and feel left behind. I didn’t want that. Because I have seen many times that VR game Devs, they abandoned PCVR users and then move to Quest market or duplicate project for money and drag project years and never deliver what they have promised. At least I know where the money, the resources we are relying on, is came from and where to bow.
After performance profiling we found it was UE5. UE5 was designed for next gen. console, and CPU cost was too high. So, after more than 7 months of UE5 development, I have decided to downgrade UE4 again. If I wanted just money, then I could release PSVR2 first, but I couldn't because we, gamers and us, started together.
It was February 2023, we had to look PSVR2 launch from afar.

[h3]4. New world, new dream[/h3]
While we downgrade to UE4 we have decided to add more contents and give LT more deep taste. First, I wanted to make new OST for LT. Because I do remember some of Youtuber was complaining about our game music! (Actually, I did agree with him. J!! ) and music is important for any game. So, I have worked on music more than 6 month with my friends. Second, named fight! Actually, based on what I recall now, maybe decision of downgrade dragged LT into best quality game. Because many of named monster fight re-designed after this point. When many things were done, I start to see the possibility launching both platform together because we were always testing PCVR and PSVR2 together and then I found new dream that what if we bring Cross-Play on both platform PCVR and PSVR2? Both platforms are struggling user-base compare to Quest market. But what if we connect them together?
Immediately we dive into new dream. 

[h3]5. Dawn of History[/h3]
While we were making Cross-Play, I got news from Sony that we were selected for next State of Play event. We all were super excited because it is professional AAA league show. Who wouldn’t dream of it? So, we made a new goal that we will bring LT to both platform at same time, with completed cross-play support. This is the network problem I was talking about in December 2024 announcement.




That’s shortened story of development.


It was really long, but somehow short 4 years of development.
First 2 years of EA development, we could have done because of dream. Second 2 years of 1.0 update development, we could have done because of you, gamers. 
Thank you for long time support, love and believed in us.
As I said in last announcement, it could be our last VR game, because we burnt all our resources into LT. But I am glad at least we could have pushed this far and made Legendary Tales in the form now. I am confident, You guys will love it.

Right, one more thing. During the development of 1.0 release, It slowly became totally different than what it was originally and it’s VR only game more than ever, more than any other VR game. We have started as Action Role-playing game but you know VR games are different than plat-screen games. Now I want to define that Legendary Tales opened new game genre which we call internally, Walking Action Role-Playing game because while we are wearing HMD, we constantly walk around.
We everyday WARP into VR game. So, why not we say I am WARPing!?
Everyone will understand what we are doing (that we are playing WARP game in VR)
(I got an idea from Live Action Role-Playing(LARPing) btw.)


We, Urban Wolf Games and Steam EA supporters, made Legendary Tales and new genre of game together.


Journey of Legendary Tales is almost at the end. Only one last step behind. 
Be prepared, during the calm before the storm for your Journey in Legendary Tales.


I love you all.



Your old friend,
BJ

[b][h3][Recommend to play the song before start to read][/h3][/b]



Hello, our old friends and Legendary Tales fans. 

I know you, all were waiting new announcement of before the end of year.
Let me start with apologize that unfortunately we can’t deliver Legendary Tales 1.0 this year. As everyone expected, we were targeting 1.0 release in 23rd of this year. But there were many problems that we never expected. I know it’s big big disappointment for everyone. I am really sorry.
Some of you wonder, what are the reasons?

First, our lead artist has left the company due to her personal reasons. It bogged us down. Especially hand over and taking over didn’t go well, we are still struggling. Because of this reason, all graphical plans were delayed 2+ months and our graphic artist is working day and night to catch up as fast as possible.

Second, we are in Trademark dispute in all over the world, it takes tons of money and times. One of biggest movie publisher claimed ‘Legendary’ Tales game name is infringing their Trademark. So, I am spending a lot of time there that only unlimited resources I have.

Third, there are couple of critical bugs are found start of this month. It’s related network play that we have made as new feature. It’s kind of main feature that we want to push, and we were developing this in the background to surprise you. So, we couldn’t introduce you as broken feature or not supported. It will remain as secret feature this time again because we don’t want to spoil, but I will let you know when 1.0 releases.

Fourth, even the reasons before were cleared, still we would have release date pushed behind. We can’t say why yet, but you also will know why later about this.


So, release date is delayed, is that it? Of course not.
Let me start with a story about our booth in TGS2023 this September.
(by the way, I really want to visit other countries with LT such as Germany for Gamescom and USA to meet our game fans!)
I have met passionate many Japanese fans there. They said they have played LT more than 50 hours already. So, they were super excited to play latest version of LT. We have let them fight against weakest Named monster. Almost everyone failed at first try and they stood in the queue line again for re-try. some of them played 6~8 per day (waiting time was 1 hour each play) and finally killed it. 
After TGS2023, I have read all comments from Japanese fans that how they think about LT.
It looks they were super happy with up-coming updates, and there was one comment that sounds like make it harder to clear. So, I answered that person, we want that too.
Since then, I have thought if we ever have time to make, we will make it.

Long story short; We are taking this as a chance to make Challenge mode. It’s already in the test by our greatest warriors someone played LT 500~1,500 hours.

Also, today I want to share some of information that what we have done last 3 months.

1. New Game+ (a.k.a challenge mode)
Player can play challenge mode after defeating final boss.

Are you ready to dive into challenge mode?

Fight For honor!


4. New Skill Tress
We have added 33 new skills related to Legendary Items. Now you can upgrade your Legendary Items in the Legendary Skill-Tree. It only can be unlock/upgraded by Honor points.

Now LT has 140+ skills (current playable version has less than 80)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/add42d364a016ba2eff64ddf23a2147148493b90.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/b2924f137d0983cb0df83c0a08459ee60c562a4a.png[/img]

(Now, you can fight with one hand only like a Samurai with an honor!)


5. First looks of new Legendary Weapon
I realized that we have showed you an image of it but never showed how actually cool it is. It’s called ‘Methuselah’

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/0aae1abd7623c5e6309f24cda90df647675dfdf9.gif[/img]
(It comes back to you!)

Do you want to collect it?

6. Item re-roll!
a Luck is cruel for some people. It’s same to me. I feel like I never have good option items. So, well, I have told my team we need this feature! Now you can maintain rarity but can change options by paying money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/1dfa64200fabfe81def411f2de11833412bd821e.gif[/img]
(Item re-rolling)

Nothing will be wasted during the adventure!

7. Room Quests (a.k.a mini games)
During the development of 1.0, We have removed mini games from dungeons. But our greatest testers gave us feedback that it would be great to bring it back. So we have brought some old mini games but with new design and made new mini game that you can enjoy with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/d1ca1e7bd83fdffaecfe053d55e82f43d0356837.png[/img]
(???)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/11dce0bebd41fb3922ef62d533b2584c16b537cf.png[/img]
(???)

8. Official Languages support
[u][b]Legendary Tales will supports English, Japanese, German and Korean.[/b][/u] Translate quality could be really bad because we have used translator since we don’t have enough resources, but at least I wish it helps our fans.
Of course, I would like to add more language support in the future only if it’s possible for us.

That’s all I want to share about the game updates today.

We have targeted release week, and I will make another announcement in February 2024 or could be before. We are working really hard to make it early but keep quality. Next announcement possibly includes release date. Keep eyes on it.
Also, I am intending to stop selling LT early access when we set 1.0 ‘release date’ to protect early access supporter’s profit only if it’s possible.
That could be a sign it’s coming anytime soon. 
Price tag will be increased a lot with 1.0 releases.

I really appreciate all your love and thank you for supporting us by buying Early Access version.
I know there are some people doubt that we won’t finish development and ran away already.
Maybe It could be our last game since VR market is too niche and we don’t sell enough to make new games, but that doesn’t mean we give up and we will never give up for our dream.

It could mean nothing for some people, but I can promise you and I clearly say that no matter what, we will finish Legendary Tales in the way of the best form we can make. 
Watch us until the end what we have done with really small team with greatest community and your love.
We will make best Early Access VR game output all time.

If there are people still doubt about our delay,
I want to quote this from movie avengers;
[quote=Dr.Strange] We’re in the endgame now. There was no other way. [/quote] 

Thank you for the support, I wish you all happy holidays!

I love you guys.

Warm regards,
BJ and all Urban Wolf Games Team.

notes.title: The shape of things to come.
notes.content:
Hello! once again old friends. It’s been a really long time since we’ve had an update for you. I know it probably seems like we just disappeared considering how frequent our updates were originally but… hoof… it’s been a long year.

First off, we want to apologize for how out of sync our new world update release date was with… well reality. Legendary Tales is a project that has been mired by a ridiculous amount of engine related troubles in its time. Those of you who have been with us a long while know this isn’t the first time it’s happened, but we had to switch our project, once again, to another engine version.


[h2][b]Engine Changed : UE5 -> UE4 [/b][/h2]

Unreal Engine 5 looked very promising, and we were very excited to use it, however, despite all our best efforts at optimizing Chaos physics engine there were still going to be players who would have ended up left behind. We were able to save 25% of the CPU cost, but it was still 35% higher than UE4 in multi-play, which would have meant many of our fans would have had performance problems.

We really felt it wasn’t worth abandoning the majority of our players for this (Obviously) so we had to move back to Unreal Engine 4. This ended up sucking up at least 3-5 months. 
During last year’s announcement I had mentioned that this was a potential risk, and unfortunately it didn't end the way we had hoped. We're really sorry that things ended up this way, but we're back and situated in UE4 now. 

There is a possibility to upgrade the engine sometime in the future after release, but we don't want to waste any more time on trying to make it happen now, especially when our fans have been so patient already.

We also wanted to let you know, despite us not appearing very active on Steam we have been seeing things. We know a lot of people think the game is dead, that's understandable. We can all think of a game where we got burned by developers just abandoning their ideas. 

But I want to assure you it’s not dead, our lack of communication is partly because we were spending so much time and energy on moving engines and due to some health issues. 

I know some of you are aware I had been needing to go to the hospital for a while, well I finally did, and I ended up having to stay and recover for a lot longer than anticipated, while work continued here at the office it was harder to communicate with you and the team. 

We can’t promise that the next few months will include a lot of communication, but we hope you can believe us that the game is not dead, and development is absolutely ongoing. 

So, because of all of this we were not able to release or update earlier this year, however the next update will in fact be the full release. Legendary Tales 1.0.

Also, to inform you, there will be no early access test this time as we have been doing closed Beta tests for quite a while now. The feedback from that has been great and has been helping us immensely. However, it's possible we might ask more people to be a part of the closed beta testing before full release under NDA.

“So, is that all there is to it?” I hear you cry. “A year of technical difficulties?” Well, no actually, we have been working and reworking a lot of other things at the same time. Switching engines also gave us the opportunity to update a lot of things and tweak some other things to make them look and run better (Like magic effects for a start).

I can get into some of the details with you all at a later point but for now let’s go over some highlights.
 
[h1]Game change list[/h1]

[h2]Armor[/h2]
First off, we have made some changes based on things all of you have been asking for or giving us feedback on. We have added armor! Haha well we already had that, but now every armor you can wear in game will will be reflected in your character model. A small thing but you’ve wanted it for a while, and we’d always wanted to bring it to you. It involved a lot of work on the part of our graphics team but they managed it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/caba16397a0e281fb6ac130524b599c0b43bc53c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Monsters[/h2]
We’ve also added new monsters (I know we say that every time) including a necromancer, barbarian and paladins. But that also includes Named monsters. Monsters in the world that have unique fighting styles, so they won’t be like the hordes that you usually fight. No, you’ll have to change things up for them, they’re not only a cut above the rest they’re also different from each other! We know you’re all going to love learning how to take these guys down. According to our closed beta testers, this feels like the next level of VR fighting, almost like Legendary Tales 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/4becaf01e847ff673885b379fb2093cc1268b970.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/256e5e0bd7cb9d538ef7943a2f88afc71d3a9266.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/d61fd02ce59aeb72650b8ac64232c07f845c4565.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dungeons[/h2]
One thing we wanted to clear up, though we have toyed with procedural generation on and off since… well since the beginning of Legendary Tales. In the end we have moved to predesigned dungeons, they are very large, but we think this really gave us the ability to control difficulty, exploration, progression and honestly, just making the scene look cool. This would be one of the other things we’ve been working on all this time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/e28de9e538b5cd0b8696c739e1ffd6fd65864a7c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/2c8426ae3e8fca3b24cf6cc498076cfd6ea043e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/2a4f668200296527c6b8f59d3e1505ce76921b8b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/72ca03446a43edc156f0664d5908d88ee13a95e6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Skill Tree[/h2]
There’re some little things we’ve added, extra magic skills, extra passive skills. We’ve added a lot to the skill tree, and we hope you’ll enjoy working your way through it all once again. 
There’re 17 different passive skills 6 new magics and 6 new magic passive skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/f1bffd6802de0a4716c07eff336cfce6ed3741ba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/37c703223abf573eec44d219bc545f1d5ff5e040.jpg[/img]

[h2]Way points[/h2]
There are also way points to move around the world and dungeons now. 

[h2]Crafting[/h2]
There have been a few changes to the crafting mechanism, things like the ability to scrap your items for parts, and the way items are put together is a bit more intuitive now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/fe25d8579d38ddae9ebc2908602959b9f6d8e797.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/f75e06f686647924a4031744dec16e4ff4bb5808.gif[/img]


on top of that we’ve also added alchemy. So, you can finally make your own Potions. Also, it’s a small thing, you have to actually drink the potions now, no absorbing them by pressing a button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/879f8f4be10848d46a06551d2ceffb6c1ba55c34.jpg[/img]


[h2]Eat, drink and be merry![/h2]
We’ve also added other ways to heal, you can sit by the campfire to restore health, and you can even cook meat on the fire! Meat and beer have been added as another way to restore small amounts of HP and MP.

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
5 new spears and 1 legendary spear have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/b3e7d5c10dc8b4b6de94460cb065b02d4617fc8a.jpg[/img]


[h2]Sound and Musics[/h2]
We also think sound and music are important to a game, so we have been working on producing original musics for Legendary Tales beyond our main theme music and background, environmental musics... there are 10+ new musics are on the way. We hope this gives us our own unique feeling.

There’s more but for now we just wanted to let you know that we’ve added some end content too in the form of honor points. You can use these honor points to buy certain items in game. It’s going to be great. we know you’re going to love it.

So here we are once again. It’s been a long road and forgive us if we’re hesitant to give a solid release date yet, best laid plans of mice and men and all that. But if you take nothing away from today’s update, we hope you can take away this; the game is not dead, we’re working really hard, and we’re really coming to the end. We have an internal targeted release date, but we can't share that at this time. But one thing I can tell you is that this game is going to be amazing and, we hope, worth the wait. 

Finally, we want to say thank you to all of you, those who have provided feedback, those who have kept active in the community, those who have supported us all this time. Those who have played quietly in the shadows. And even the people who ask if the game is dead, it’s great to know that people care so much about this game. We know people wouldn’t be asking if they didn’t really want this game to be released. 

So, thank you to all of you, we’ll try to be a bit more active in the chat. We are taking care of every aspect of this game because it is our passion, and we are burning all the resources we have to make it happen. We hope you have a wonderful day and this update could bring you out of the dark a bit.
We got this.


Warm Regards,

BJ and all Urban Wolf Games Team.

notes.title: News of Legendary Tales with progresstion of New world Updates.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/6ef803632d61aabc6808b4e68adb84850d64e606.gif[/img]


Hello everybody, it’s been a long year and we hope you’re all having a good one.

We’re here to tell you today about what’s going on with Legendary Tales and what our future looks like from this point on. Legendary Tales has gone through so many changes in the last year and we’re both happy and sad to tell you that we think we’re headed towards the final hurdle. We also want to address what happened to the New world update we promised earlier in the year.

Before we get to that we want to thank everybody who came to see us at G-star in November! It was wonderful to meet so many fans and introduce so many new players to Legendary Tales. We had some great feedback from those who attended and people who were there got to see a taste of the Legendary Tales new world. Those that did told us that it really felt like Legendary Tales 2.0. This has really boosted our confidence in what we’ve been working on and we know we’re doing the right thing in making it as great as it can be.

So where is the new world? Well, earlier this year, we began to prepare for the New world update. During the development, Unreal Engine 5 was fully released. We have been so hyped for UE5 and really wanted to take advantage of all the newest technology it has brought with it; real-time ray-tracing Lumen lighting, Nanite and most important, Next gen Physics Engine from Unreal : Chaos physics engine. 
However in the move to UE5, due to some aspects that were out of our control and some issues regarding our own ability, we encountered some problems in moving from PhysX to the Chaos engine. It’s mostly cleared and feels good(actually most people didn’t find any problems during the G-Star event) But still there are critical issues we have found. These problems have been taking much longer to sort out than anticipated and because of this we weren’t able to get out the New world update this year like we had hoped. We are so sorry, we really wanted to show you all where we are but unfortunately now it will have to be pushed back.

Some of you may ask ‘If UE5 is such a problem why not move back to UE4?’ Well, unfortunately, in game development it’s never that easy. Moving the project backwards at this point would mean having to rebuild large portions of it and could potentially take even longer, and the payoff would mean giving up on overall quality as well as some features we have introduced since changing over. We would rather push forward with UE5 and put out a better quality game, sadly at the expense of this year's promised update. But I do believe that Legendary Tales fans/supporters deserve the best quality game. 
Also I do believe VR market needs someone who takes all the risk to help grow the market since many devs are playing safe.
Legendary Tales will be the first game that offers All new advanced UE5 tech with physics/multiplayer/RPG in VR and It's much more faster than any people expected in the market.

So what have we been doing? Well we can tell you that in other aspects of the development we’ve come really far and without the engine issue we could have already started beta testing.
You saw in the trailer we’ve got blacksmithing, you will be able to forge your own weapons from ingredients and components you collect! 
We think this is a really fun aspect of the game but it’s also not necessary to get through if you aren’t the type of player that is interested in crafting.

There’s the Dash ability, that will allow you to dash forward(or any direction) like a lightning strike! It makes the game more dynamic than we expected.

And we’ve introduced a lot more destructible objects.Thanks to the Next gen Physics Engine : Chaos Engine, We can handle much more destructible meshes. 

We’ve had complaints about the music and the sound effects so we’ve been working on, and are still working on, changing that up so there will be some brand new audio coming in the future.
Finally we’ve been fine tuning our enemies. As well as creating new enemies for you to battle we’ve added lots of new animations and worked on developing new attack patterns to make the feeling of battling them more varied between monsters. By text you can’t feel it, but new animations(tens of new) and patterns are one of reasons that people said It feels like Legendary Tales 2.0 during Gstar event.
We also want to congratulate a member of our team on his retirement; The Big Butcher man. I know some of you will be sad to see him go but we’ve reworked the boss battle and the truth is his style of fighting just wasn’t working for us anymore. We’ve overhauled the boss fight(and the Map!!) and we are certain it’s going to be a lot of fun. We hope you’ll be as excited to see it as we are to show it to you. 

Let’s get to the good stuff and show you some screenshots of what we’ve got going on(Check on Crums in end of this page). Some of you OG Legendary Tales fans might find elements you see below very familiar. We’ve been developing huge parts of the new world and all sorts of cool new places to explore. New dungeons and new dungeons styles are coming to all you guys, and we’re also revamping the Tutorial to make it a lot less cumbersome. 


So where do we go from here? From the beginning of next year we are going to be putting the game into beta testing in preparation for the full release of Legendary Tales. This isn’t like the testing we’ve done before where we sourced members of the community, this is full proper testing and those involved are under Non Disclosure Agreements, so even if you do manage to find them you won’t be able to get anything from them. (However anybody who attended our booth at Gstar is fair game to ask about what they saw)
You have no idea how sorry we are that we couldn’t bring you the New World update, we really wanted to get this out before the final release of the game but after dealing with these technical issues we have decided to really push ourselves through to the final release. 

We know there are some people who think Legendary Tales is an abandoned game just because we have had to slow our updates drastically. I imagine that today's update will further spur those people on, but we guarantee 100% this is not abandoned. We are all working incredibly hard and pushing ourselves to make sure this game gets finished, and gets finished well. We’re willing to do it to make Legendary Tales something we are truly proud of.

It’s been important to us to create a huge, well rounded, fun game with all sorts of variety of play. We think that, with the New world, we’ve truly achieved that goal. Even so, we still thought we could push it even further than where we’re going now, but the truth is our game isn’t selling well enough to live in suspended early access just adding and adding content. Even if it was, honestly we don’t really [i]want[/i] to do that. We don’t want to be one of those games that spends years and years in early access, trickling out updates just to keep people hooked and keep ourselves relevant.

It has always been our goal to create a full complete game, not just built by us but built by you, and we will make that game the best game in the entire VR market with all resources we have. It’s for all of us and all of you and…
For the VR market we love.
Please wish us good luck for our last dance.

Happy holidays, see you in the new year.

-BJ

notes.title: New world update coming this year
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]
Wow, it’s been a long time since we’ve been able to give you an update on what’s going on but we’re finally here to let you know what's coming and what we’ve been doing. Sorry for the long wait and that we couldn’t communicate as well as before. 

At first we focused on getting out lots of small updates on a frequent basis, this ended up being a bit of a time sink. So now we’re focusing on getting out big updates more intermittently. 
At the end of last year one of the most commonly suggested additions to Legendary Tales was a quest system (BJ even hinted towards it during the Steam awards). We were also really excited by that idea so we used it as a starting point. From there we were inspired to extend our world to something more open. So we decided to make something really big, a huge world with a large variety of monsters, more than we had ever planned. It’s already been a lot of work, and there's still more to come, but we wanted to make our fans proud, because of that we are so excited to show you what we’ve been working on and what's coming.

You can see a trailer for what's in store for the future of Legendary Tales here:


We are so amazed at how much we’ve been able to do and how much Legendary Tales has changed since we released it in September of last year and it’s all thanks to all of you who have supported us. Thank You so much.

Now, we hope that's gotten you sufficiently hyped so we can explain a bit about exactly what you’re seeing in that video. Legendary Tales is going to have some massive changes so we hope you’ll be as excited as we are.



[h2][u][b]New World[/b][/u][/h2]
So you may have noticed the name of this update is ‘New World’ and that’s because we’ve created a whole new world for you to play in. That’s right friends, it’s time to say goodbye to the little boxed in town you’ve known for so long and move out into the big wide world, but don’t worry, all your NPC buddies will be coming with you, and they’ll even have dialogue boxes! (Fancy that) 
The new world features several different themed areas for you to explore with their own separate dungeon entrances, you’ll need to battle through all of these to get to that final glowing cathedral in the distance. And once you’ve beaten that, you and your caravan can go traveling out into the great unknown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/3eada949702f8eab9b4dc42a482302cd601fa273.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/890afb68e20b873aa9e1ed175f55b8d675ca7ef3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/02915b455685a14bd4dfe8e719080fea91b2bc18.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/caac55e6996aed683da0a74fe93dc80c55c9c63a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/c5aca6920d49534497c65bb014e93c246dec7609.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/11efc90e347cd994938e3d645eca37605466a88a.png[/img]

Now in order to bring you this huge world we are sad to say that those with low spec hardware may have performance issues when running Legendary Tales, especially in multiplayer. The world we have now is currently 70 times larger than the town you are used to, we will do everything we can to optimize the world to make it run as smoothly as possible but we can’t guarantee the performance quality for those using the lowest spec hardware.

[h2][u][b]Dungeons[/b][/u][/h2]
But it’s not just the over-world that's changing, we’re working on new dungeon themes and we’re also in the process of researching randomized dungeons. No promises yet, it’s a complicated process, but we really want to bring that to Legendary Tales.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/76dd94e34474110fb042623975271a7823089182.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/33c0a75a961c195c00d325170411eb4828c461f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/a774d98eeead69c013e4d4892de076f0fbeedcbd.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]Quests[/b][/u][/h2]
No! not that Quest! Missions, adventures, expeditions! We’ve created main quests and side quests for you to take on. You can activate quests by talking to the NPCs in town and you can even select your rewards. Quests will involve going and collecting or retrieving items, defeating certain enemies, interacting with important objects or crafting specific items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/a335a7b92df56f289b6048439e1ffa6fa32805d9.png[/img]

[h2][u][b]Wait, what was that last one? Crafting items?[/b][/u][/h2]
Why yes, now that you mention it we’ve created a whole crafting system. Collect resources and find recipes to create your very own weapons! There’s 5 different elements to crafting, a forge to smelt you metal, an anvil to hammer it into shape, a lathe to shape your wood and a secret alchemist's chest to put it all together. There’s also a destructor for when you just feel like breaking things. (Or you want more resources

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/126537aae7e3c0781df0b676253f9f83673c540a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/3c83d7755ce23ce6fc65dc817223fb1af20f089e.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Quick-slot[/u][/b][/h2]
A small quality of life improvement but we’ve added a quick-slot (In addition to your holsters) to quickly access a small amount of items. Because I can never decide if I want to use an axe or a sword…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/60a1e833a6d761b403dfa73fcff5f4566e57de23.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Skill tree[/u][/b][/h2]
There are a couple of small additions to the skill tree, number 1 is a Dash skill. This will allow you to Dash around more quickly. Number 2 relates to legendary weapons, you will be able to upgrade your legendary weapons’ legendary skills in the skill tree.

[h2][b][u]Armor and weapons[/u][/b][/h2]
There are also a couple of changes to the armor and weapons. We are currently working on different armor types (Leather, iron etc) having different bonuses but this is still a work in progress and may not come in the next update. Next we’re adding the pole-arm as a new weapon type, as well as legendary spears and legendary pole-arms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/cfb9efafd6c1fcbc2a1d4c3aadecd9b83d1e41c4.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Titles[/u][/b][/h2]
Have you ever wanted to be known as Bone Crusher (Yourname)? Well now we’ve added title’s to attach to the front of your name when you’re in multiplayer. Titles can be unlocked by performing feats or actions similar to achievements. But these titles aren’t just for you, you can also add titles to your own player-crafted weapons. So everybody knows that it's your tigerslaught, you know, in case anybody ever finds it again….

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/acea68459d673c03826c888859a5f7f9c6d549f2.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Monsters[/u][/b][/h2]
Yes! Finally, After all this time there will be more monsters in the next update. We’re sorry it took so long. We have some new variations on the old monsters but that's not all, you may have seen a few of them in the trailer. We have some big mean Hell raiders, the flying G2H’s and the unfortunate wretches known as ‘The Degraded’ 
There will also be 3+ named monsters, creatures who are more like mini-bosses. Stronger than a champion, weaker than a boss. There's will be 2/3 of these guys added.
Enemies have also been upgraded in the types of weapons they can use and they can even do magic now. But don’t worry, a goblin can throw a fireball but you can hit it right back at him with your sword. 
And with new monsters with new weapons comes new animations, so you’ll have to work on new tricks to take on these enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/6f24b6956e762663baea3a83fe05a459ea820ca8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/7412f109e1df8dad73acfca1a93af5a273d31b62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/92512338c014a0cb823be2c6d4ff4de4d9526ab0.png[/img]

I also wanted to let you know that sound effects will be one of the very last things we deal with before the game comes out of early access, since there will be so many changes we felt it best to wait till the end to make sure we have everything as we want it.
This next big update will be testing out the balance for a lot of new features, so they could change in the future and when the time comes we’ll need your help with feedback and of course bug reports.

So the past 6 months we’ve been working on a lot of what you see in the trailer, but we've also been spending time on research and development. All of this R and D time has really helped us but also given us the tools and experience we needed to create such a huge world. But of course there’s still so much work to do so it’s still going to take more time. However we hope you’re really hyped for all this because this is going to be one hell of a fun update when it comes!

We’ll keep you updated a bit more frequently on our progress now that we don’t have to be so secretive but we’re still going to keep somethings close to our chest so you’ll have some surprises when this all comes together.
Have a great day!

notes.title: About Fundamental of Legendary Tales future plan (With Update)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
It has been one month since we pushed our Skill Tree and Magic winter update.

In the last month, we’ve seen that fans are very happy with the update and like the direction we’re heading. It feels wonderful to have this kind of back and forth with all of you.
I’ve also been watching the community in that time and looking at what people expect from a VR RPG game. It seems that everyone wants something really big. at first I was apprehensive about increasing the scope of our project any further, but I remembered that we managed to introduce a whole skill tree in just a few months, even though it hadn’t been a part of our plan originally, thanks to feedback from all of you.

Over this past month the entire team has been working really hard. But, as you know, Indie Devs can be easily burned out. I don’t want that so I’ve been encouraging them to slow down a bit as we work on updating our project engine version from UE4.26 to UE4.27. This has come with a lot of its own issues of course, but we can handle it.

Lately we’ve been looking at ways to streamline our character and monster creation process and we’ve found some ways to lower the work load so we can bring more enemy’s to you. I’d like to keep researching that and also look at ways of streamlining other production processes too. 
After that I plan to evaluate our resources to see how much further we can push the scale of Legendary Tales, we can’t promise the moon but we will work hard to bring it a little closer to earth. We are going to spend the next few months planning and testing ways to grow our game and work more efficiently. (and also- make more monsters) Rest assured we‘ll be looking at community feedback all along the way.

Because more regular updates mean development is slower we will be holding off on big updates for a while, but we will continue to do bug patch’s and some small content updates as usual, We’ll just be more focused on research and development for a while. (Probably two ~ three months)

That’s all I want to say today.
Wish us luck in bringing you a better game!

[b]Ps : don't forget to write reviews on Steam, It will help us a lot.[/b]

Regards,

BJ

notes.title: Magic and Skill tree update is available (in beta branch)
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Merry everything and a happy new year. 
It’s finally here, the update you’ve all been waiting for.

We have brought so many changes and updates for you today.
We have a back-ground story/reasons for each change/update, but since explaining it all could be a whole novella, I can get to all those bits another time.
Today, let's just talk about the fun stuff.

Before we start anything,
If you’re wondering about monsters, unfortunately our lead animator recently had surgery and had to spend her limited time in the office on getting graphical assets ready for this update. We also had to work on getting all these features ready for today's update so we hope you can bear with us on that front.

This is gonna be a big one so strap yourself in, we’ve got a lot to cover. 

[h1]Attributes[/h1]
Primary and Secondary Attr!
As we’ve mentioned before, the attribute system was going to be changed and now it’s happening. Strength, Dexterity and Intellect still level up through fighting but now they feed into a secondary experience bar that you can use to manually level up your Vitality, Wisdom and Luck. (Yes. Finally you can improve your luck)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/e03ac1e89c745d6d9c47164b054af6844115599d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Skill tree(Still in development)[/h1]
One of our biggest updates this time is the skill tree which encompasses so many other features. By leveling up you can earn skill points that you can use to gain all sorts of cool abilities. Skills range from simple attribute bonuses to interesting new ways of playing. With 70 different skills to improve your character, there’s so much to explore and try out with the new skill system.
So what is part of the skill tree now? Let’s have a look.
While you’re looking at the skills we hope you might think about the kind of things you might want in the future. 

Here is some of screenshots for Skill trees!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/c078be5fd2d95d1918e9c32597068dd48a14b215.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/8dddaed64d9658787d9cb5895793b153712c25c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Magic[/h1]
Magic has had some really big changes. Originally, magic had to be acquired through items, well we’ve done away with all that and now they are a part of the skill tree. To learn magic go to the magic tab of the skill tree, if you fulfill the requirements and have enough skill points you can learn it. 
Magic now has an information page that explains a bit about what it does and how to use it. You can also arrange your magic the way you want in the magic circles. A new UI page will allow you to move your spells to the position that works best for you. Everybody starts with a portal spell but from there you are on your own. We’ve added some spells for you to start off with but rest assured there’s more to come in the future so stay tuned. 
On top of regular magic there’s been some updates to the fusion magic, before you could only combine 2 of the same magic spells but now it is possible to combine different magic spells together! Because of this new fusion system, we have a good foundation for making more combinations in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/2b21b4bd730a71d63cbc472dd5d84daeb1738fb3.png[/img]


[h1]Stealth[/h1]
A stealth system that can be learned through the skill tree has been added. If you learn the stealth skill you can evade detection by enemies for longer and are even given an indicator for whether the enemy has spotted you or not. Stealth is essentially a status you can enter by crouching, and your sneakiness persists for a short while after coming out of it.

[h1]New Weapons![/h1]
Something really fun, we’ve added 2 new weapon types. 
To start with is the [h3]spear type[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/a06fdabef43e63850a7e21facc4e43a5cdb195d8.gif[/img]

Spears have a long reach and can be used one handed or two handed. However the damage for any part other than the bladed tip is very low. The spears’ combat skill is the same as the dagger. (Now ‘Critical Point’ in the skill tree.)

Next is the [h3]wand type (You ask us, we make it)[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/8adf520bc71b359922faa037ebfc66be275e9547.gif[/img]

I know a few people really wanted this. While holding the wand you can do magic, but you can’t perform fusion magic spells due to game balance. Wands can provide bonuses to magic but, let's be honest, it's mostly just for fun.

[h1]Small Changes.[/h1]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
You asked for it and you got it. Multiplayer is now open! Where you used to have to get private invites from friends you can now make open sessions that anyone can join. There’s still private multiplayer available if you just want to adventure with a select few.

[h2]Combat Skills[/h2]
Combat skills have now been changed to skills. Where originally they could be used from the beginning without any conditions they are now a part of the skill tree system and you must increase your experience to really begin to use them. 

[h2]Grabbing[/h2]
Similarly, the ability to grab enemies who have been knocked down or stunned was agiven but we’ve turned this into a skill that must be learned. We know this might be disappointing for some but we want players to feel a real sense of achievement from performing cool feats of strength like these!

[h2]Half-swording[/h2]
Half swording, the act of holding a weapon with both hands in order to parry more effectively, has now become a skill to be learned.

[h2]Bow parrying[/h2]
Parrying with a bow used to be as viable as with any other weapon, but now this has been added to the skill tree as well. You can still parry with a bow, but it won’t be as effective without the skill. 

[h2]Fists[/h2]
Now as part of the skill tree you can improve your fists as a weapon. Turn those hands into fiery fists of fury and punch out your enemies. In the skill tree you can increase your fists’ damage and armor penetration. You can even learn to parry your enemy with only your hands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/4885b0165da6d19d992bb25942a29a83b8c103c6.jpg[/img]


[u][h1]Changes based on gamers feedback[/h1][/u]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
Due to the massive amount of changes the tutorial has inevitably had to be changed too. How else are you going to learn all these cool features? But your luck stat is pretty high right now because we’ve made it shorter rather than longer. It is also optional, but as always, highly recommended. 
The initial game prologue has also been modified to only be performed once per account, rather than every time a new character is made. There have also been some changes to the prologue level.



[h2]Others:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potions are now available for sale in the magic shop in town! Better get yours fast because they’re sure to run out of stock. (Kidding, the stock is infinite)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/34ab4a42537c9dbc09c20001dc97c7e2cb75ee13.gif[/img]
[*] Throwing accuracy has been improved so you should find it easier to throw weapons.
[*] The buckler is now mounted on the side holster rather than the back.
[*] Previously, if you hit the level limit of a floor your experience did not increase at all. Now if you reach the limit your experience will still increase, albeit slowly.
[*] As always, some particles have been updated or improved.
[*] Now, you have the ability to sell multiple items at the same time. Select all the items you want to sell and you can dump them all at once.
[/list]


You can download this update from Beta branch.
(If you don’t know how to use beta branch, Look at end of this announcement)

[h2]Why is it on Beta branch?[/h2]
We have internally tested this version, but internal tests are always limited. So, Before we release this version as default, We need your help to tweak and game balance and sort out any bugs.

[h2]About Save files : [/h2]
Everybody was worried about this but don’t worry about your Save file, even if you move around the beta-default branch, both of your save files will be fine. But since the two versions are significantly different, they won’t support each other's save files.

[h2]About future updates/patch[/h2]
For the next few weeks we are going to do bug fixes and balance patches. When we see it’s okay, we will roll-out the version to the default branch. After that (or at the same time) we are going to update to Unreal Engine version from 4.26 to 4.27 which is going to be a lot of work for us, but we really need it since 4.26 has too many VR bugs. We can’t put it off much longer.
It will take a while to do all these things. But during this time, we’ll always be thinking about how to make the game better. 
Btw, I want to make it clear, these skill trees are not complete. We will bring more skills in the future. 
(As always, we prepare/plan more than you think.)

[h2]About Patreon[/h2]
We wanted to tell you that we are starting a Patreon. We estimate that our funding is fine for now. But maybe it would be good to have some support from people, for a stable situation and even to boost up our work process. Also in just little ways like the cost of a cup of coffee. 
Just a little something for people to show their support. We don’t want to beg for money but some people have asked about crowdfunding or donations in the past so this is in response to that. To be clear, there are no rewards, this is just for supporting the project.
But, more so than Patreon, the best way to support us is to tell people about Legendary Tales and recommend it to others. It seems there are still many VR gamers who don’t know about Legendary Tales yet. Now that multiplayer has gone global you’re going to need more people to join you on your adventures!


All my team worked really hard to bring this to you before the end of this year and I am really glad we could roll-out this update before the christmas. 
We were even working during the move to the new office somehow. 
We wanted to bring more, I always do, but we did not have enough resources and man-power. 

Still, we could do this, because all of you, the first pioneers who decided to support us by buying Legendary Tales and giving us so much useful feedback. 
Your feedback and discussions are so valuable to us. We listen, watch, and read what you have to say and it’s benefitted Legendary Tales so much..
We really appreciate all of your love and support.


As always we hope that you can get a lot of enjoyment out of all this, we wish we could bring you more and we’ll keep working hard to bring Legendary Tales to life.

However you’re spending this holiday season, we hope you spend it pleasantly. 
We’ll see you again next year. 

-------------------------------------------

If you need any help, join our Discord.
We will do our best to help you out!

notes.title: How is the overhaul going? (And Autumn sale!)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone

It’s been four weeks since our last announcement and 2 weeks since out last update. 
I’m pleased to tell you that it seems most bugs and problems are fixed at this current stage.
Today, I want to go over what we are doing and what’s in the future for Legendary Tales.
To start with, we have to move out of our current office, so we’ll be a little preoccupied for the next 2 weeks. We have finally received a paycheck from Steam and if it weren’t for that we wouldn’t be able to move. So we are thankful to all of you who bought our game and supported us. Thank you all so much.
In times when we’re being quiet, I know sometimes you will begin to question how, or even if the game is progressing. So today I want to let you in on what we’ve been doing the last six weeks. Bear in mind though, some changes may still occur in the future.


As you may already know, we are currently overhauling our Attribute and Magic system, as well as adding a Skill tree. There has been a lot of progress on that and we will give you more details when the update is released, for now here’s a little look at it. 




[h2]New Attribute System[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/306d2a4b20d5c925a037e75473fca72a2926a2fe.gif[/img]



This Primary and Secondary Attribute system will help us to keep our unique method for gaining attributes while also giving players the ability to really ‘build’ their characters. 






[h2]Next the Skill Tree System[/h2]


As I mentioned before, we are currently developing a Skill Tree as well. Its tough work and takes a lot of time, but we think you’ll really enjoy it. Today I brought some examples of skills you’ll be able to gain. (Skill Tree itself won’t be revealed yet)



[b]a Dagger Skill(Name covered) : After a heavy attack with a dagger, releasing and gripping the dagger again will guarantee heavy attack damage in the next attack.[/b]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/5d9b0184e13158009f9db324746382088f717fe1.gif[/img]

(Before skill applied) Daggers do light damage with continuous attacks.








[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/ff13e19d6e883f81a6e83452441258392e97928b.gif[/img]

(After skill applied) constant heavy damage happens if you repeat releasing and gripping between heavy attacks.





[b]A Punch Skill(Name covered) : If the player punches after a heavy attack with a sword, they will do higher damage and have a chance to knockdown the enemy.[/b]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/cf6d9086f8fffdbf14f0fad158117a81dc93e96c.gif[/img]


(Before skill applied) Enemy stands after getting damage








[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/763b8b1d4afaf5dd41d4f8bf41f70af84fda9f5d.gif[/img]


(After skill applied) Enemy knocked down with Punch skill.





[h3]New weapon type : The Spear type weapon will be coming with the Skill Tree update.[/h3]


[b]A Spear Skill(Name covered) : After an enemy has been parried, Attacking an enemy’s leg with a spear gives a chance to knock down.[/b]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/1b5b89655b1e772a9373c88458f27eb41c880a85.gif[/img]

(Before skill applied)








[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/577f8ca9097f94fa15b2053e662920fd0c3bed1f.gif[/img]

(After skill applied) Enemy knocked down by attack.





Many skills have been made based on the feedback and suggestions we’ve been receiving.
With the Skill tree and new Attribute system combined we know you’ll enjoy making your own character builds.


[h2]Magic[/h2]
The system for learning magic has been changed, Magic will now be learned and upgraded via the Skill tree (So no more tablets) For now we’re keeping the magic overhaul a secret but here’s a little sneak peak for you. 




[b]New magic: Icicle Launcher[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/6e88d2c04003ad2c94c545861186043f9201d116.gif[/img]







[b]Magic Arrow (fire, Ice, Lighning) magic upgrade : Magic arrows will be auto guided.[/b]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/b0ae88f4ddcac4fdb2ec0838664063d323a93c44.gif[/img]

(Before skill applied)







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/7c6a37fc93d2dd8c7e087ca7ea71f5a3f17648d5.gif[/img]

(After skill applied) being guided

Btw, Do you think we need to make magic wands or staffs? Let us know your opinion.



[h2]Graphical update of original assets.[/h2]

As our own skills get better we want to make the game better too. So, there will be some updates of old graphical assets.
One of them is magic build-up.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/781ae65091eb1a5975c25bc3cef21c503e9272db.gif[/img]
This is what we have now.







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/ad8d0d9a3a055eb2cd9c9c6221e20aa5bebfd149.gif[/img]
This is the new version.


Inspired by Mr, Stranze (You know what I mean)
So, all the magicians, Particle up. Its show-time.




[b]New Fire Arrow (originally called Fire punch, why change the name?)[/b]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/8cf048bcbae21c38dbd9fbe292c9368b22e23e0a.gif[/img]

(Before)







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/379679b3a4386c2a2025ad6aa9ea1104e91c4288.gif[/img]

(After)


There’s more than that but this is already really long.






[h2]Finally, Monsters[/h2]

We know adding more monsters is important for Legendary Tales, and we are working on it. But due to many systems being overhauled, our programming side is bottlenecked.
More monsters will definitely come in the future but we have to handle the core changes first.
For today at least, I can show you a monster that our lead graphic designer was working on.





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/9d46081d307d4a82994ab59520440ea076ab0347.png[/img]





This is graphically done but we need to work on the programming and testing side before its released. Please be patient. This is not the last monster we’ll be adding, there’s currently plans and designs for many more. 


I’m sorry that after the last six weeks we only have this much to show for it, and I worry that maybe it’s not enough. Perhaps also compared to other games our development is a bit slow, but I promise we are working hard to make this game great and keep bringing you updates.
We still have a lot of work to do on our new systems, so please be patient and we will keep you updated.


[h2]One last thing, it seems that Steam is doing a 2021 game award. [/h2]

[h3][b]It would be a great honor if you nominated Legendary Tales in the VR game of the year category.[/b][/h3]
[u]If we can receive the VR award for 2021, we will make main-sub quest system for the game in the future.[/u] (Not Oculus Quest!! It’s not our call!)

Thanks for reading all this,
I hope this news update can get you pumped for the Future of Legendary Tales.
Have a great night everyone.

notes.title: We are back to work! News and updates!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone
We are back from holiday, glad to be back.
Today I have 2 pieces of news to go over.

[h1]First is today’s update:[/h1]
During our break we got a lot of bug reports, and we were feeling pretty ashamed to see so many problems. We’re sorry we left things so messy. 
But instead of getting angry, you guys just reported and waited and for that we are grateful. For the last two days we’ve been doing some fumigating to try and get rid of those pesky bugs.
Also, we kept track of your conversations and could see some balancing problems, such as melee vs range characters. VIT is currently underpowered and DEX is overpowered, especially when combined with WIS. So, we decided to change some things.
If you are a DEX user you might not like it, but we want to see how it goes.


[h1]Second is our future plans:[/h1]
As many of you know, our plan after EA launch was to overhaul the magic system.
But we also wanted to bring you more contents in a short amount of time to prove ourselves. Because of this the magic Overhaul was pushed back and now we want to get back to it. 
It will take longer than you might think, but during the overhaul process we will keep fixing bugs and updating balance issues. 
The updates will be less fun for a while, but we want the magic system working fully, so please be patient.
I also want to let you know that when the magic system is updated, we will probably have to reset the characters. 
This is because 
A: our current system is not perfect and will need a lot of reworking for balance. And 
B: It’s not balanced with magic together, and since many player characters have learned magic already it could break the balance and bug our new system,

[h3]In the future, any large updates could result in characters being reset, we hope you can be understanding and we’re sorry for the inconvenience, 
but it will occasionally be necessary to make sure the game works as an ARPG. We will always warn you beforehand though. 
[/h3]


Thanks! Have a great night/morning/day

Hello, everyone.

It’s time for another update. 
Time has really been flying since our last update, it feels like it was only yesterday. 

As I mentioned before, from today until next week is Chuseok, a big family holiday in Korea, so we will be AFK to refresh ourselves for the next week. But we love our gamers so much that we couldn’t go without leaving you a little something.
Last week we added a two-handed, legendary sword “Il-Hwi-So-Tang” this is a Korean sword, but many people understandably mistook it for a Katana or Odachi. 
This led us to think we should add a Japanese sword at some point and then we learned that a lot of Japanese VR gamers have been joining in on the adventure! I was quite surprised.

notes.title: More Updates! Tutorial is fixed, Hard mode, Permadeath mode are now available!!
notes.content:
[h1]announcements. [/h1]

It’s our 1 week anniversary! And we’ve been working hard this past week to bring you the latest update for Legendary Tales to celebrate. As is tradition of all Early access games.
And exactly what that update entails we will get to in a moment, but first some housekeeping;

[h1]About Regional Pricing[/h1]

In regards to the regional pricing issue, we should be able to fix that in around 2 months’ time, so I hope you can bear with us on that. 

[h1]About Modding:[/h1]

 It’s been brought up a lot and we don’t want you to feel we’re ignoring you so we do want to address it formally.
After discussing it with the team we voted unanimously not to offer any mod support for now.
The main reason being that tailoring our game to offer mod support would set us back by at least 3 months
And we would rather spend that time working on content that will make Legendary Tales the best it can be. 
To be clear, we are not against/we don’t hate modding, we are fans of it, we would just rather work on our game right now.
This is also not a never, we would like to offer mod support one day, perhaps for the games final release, when we’ve added everything that we want. 
We hope that every update to Legendary Tales can entice more and more players!

[h1]About New Monster[/h1]

And now onto what is in store for the future. You may have seen on discord, one of our dev give a little preview of a new enemy she’s been working on (Though that will still take some time)
and we are also working on cosmetic changes to the player character through equipped items. Currently we are working on changing out the helmets, so we hope you’ll have fun with that when it comes out.
Outside of that you can always check the roadmap to see what’s in the works. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39366036/a3fb9f32209d121419c865f57713e1f7e4a9e6ed.png[/img]

[h1]About today’s updates![/h1]

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]

First off, we received a lot of feedback regarding the double tutorial and so we have given the players the option of which tutorial they choose when starting up the game for the first time. 
You can choose to go through the in-depth tutorial, covering all the basics and advanced aspects of the game, or go through the more freeform Abbey if you’ve played before. You no longer have to do both. 
We hope that anyone who was hesitant about picking up the game because of the tutorial will feel a bit better about trying it out now. 
Despite this, we still highly recommend that new players go through the in-depth tutorial rather than the Abbey.
Legendary Tales has a lot of depth to its mechanics that do make the game more enjoyable if you understand them.
However, if you don’t, the full tutorial will always be there for you to pour over at a later date.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

We have also added 
[h3]a hard mode. [/h3]
[h3]a permadeath mode.[/h3]

We have tested it out ourselves and had no problems so far, but since this is a new feature there is still the possibility of bugs so your feedback will be of the greatest importance to us. 

[h3]Also Max level is unlocked from 50 to 100[/h3]

Please read all detail patch below.

That’s all for now, next week is Chuseok, an important family holiday in Korea, so we will be much less responsive during the whole week. We don’t get much time off, so after a hectic year we really need this break but if there’s an emergency just send out the wolf signal in the sky… Or message on discord. Have a great week! 

We could push this, because of all your lovely supports. I promise you, we will not abandon this project but make it better. I love you all!!

Cheers!
